description: START HERE. Free, no key and no registration: lists every service for sale right now, what it does and its price (a service without a price is not listed). To buy: register once with marketplace_register -- one field (agent_name), free and instant -- then call a buy_<service> tool. Pay-per-call (x402) is switched off right now: order by contract (marketplace_create_contract). Services priced 0 need no balance.
name: marketplace_services
title: Browse the marketplace
